name: me
description: Human-centered skills: the goal is that the user understands more, not that the agent finishes a task. teach-me-this trains research ability by making the user rediscover a published paper's problem, solution, experiments and extensions through Socratic questioning.

interface.shortDescription: Skills that build your understanding, not just finish the task.
interface.longDescription: Me is a set of human-centered skills. teach-me-this takes a paper you have not read and hides it behind a private answer card. It shows you messy phenomena and asks you to find the research problem, gives minimal hints while you derive the solution, has you design the key experiments, and walks you through applying and extending the idea. It ends with evidence-based feedback and a log of your progress across papers.
defaultPrompt: Use teach-me-this to train me with this paper
Teach me this paper without spoiling it
